name: thumbnail
title: Thumbnail
description: The picture that identifies a row: a product, a document, a frame of a recording. A fixed box, so it never becomes the row's height driver and every row in the column is the same height whatever the image is. `Avatar` is the one for a person (it is round and falls back to initials); `CardMedia` is the one for a card, where the frame IS the content. Copy: the `alt` says what the picture shows, not
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Thumbnail.json
